name: mana-vault
description: Manage your Magic collection, coach and edit decks, and analyze trades in ChatGPT and Codex.

interface.longDescription: Connect your Mana Vault account to search owned Magic: The Gathering cards, coach decks using current card rules and stats, preview and apply deck edits, record newly acquired cards, and analyze your trade offers. ChatGPT can identify names and quantities in photos you provide; Mana Vault resolves those names and previews additions to your binder and optional deck. Approve each saved preview before changes are applied. Exact printing, foil status, and condition are not inferred from a photo. Trade analysis reads only rooms you can access and does not accept or execute trades. A Mana Vault account is required. The plugin does not purchase cards or process payments.
defaultPrompt: Coach one of my Mana Vault decks using cards I already own.
Help me add newly purchased cards from a photo to Mana Vault.
Analyze my active Mana Vault trade.
